name: usage_events
title: Usage Events
description: One measured thing happened: tokens consumed, a task run, a gigabyte-hour held. Append-only, because a bill must be reconstructable from the facts that produced it -- a customer disputing an invoice is entitled to the line items behind it, and a mutable usage table cannot answer that. event_id is a CALLER-supplied idempotency key and the most important field here: retries are the number one corruption source in metering, and a client that resends after a timeout must not be charged twice for one call. cost_minor stamps what the usage cost US at the moment it happened, which is what makes margin a fold over stored facts instead of a spreadsheet somebody maintains separately -- a billing system that knows revenue but not cost cannot answer which customer loses money. Rating never reads this collection: it reads the period summaries folded from it (object_billing), which is the boundary that lets the write side change later without touching pricing.

fields.name: event_id
fields.label: Event Key
fields.help: Caller-supplied idempotency key, unique per owner. Resending the same key records nothing -- a timeout retry must never bill twice.

fields.name: metric
fields.label: Metric
fields.help: What was measured, matching a key in the plan's prices (ai.tokens, storage.gb_hours, tasks.run).

fields.name: quantity
fields.label: Quantity
fields.help: How much. A count or measure, not money -- may be fractional (gigabyte-hours), and read with Decimal wherever it is summed.

fields.name: unit
fields.label: Unit
fields.help: What the quantity counts (tokens, gb_hours, requests). Documentation for humans; the metric name is what pricing matches on.

fields.name: cost_minor
fields.label: Our Cost
fields.help: What this usage cost the business, stamped at the moment it happened under the vendor price THEN -- later price changes must not restate history.

fields.name: reference
fields.label: Reference
fields.help: The task, request or object that caused it, so a line on a bill can be traced to the work.

fields.name: rated
fields.label: Rated
fields.help: Set once folded into a period summary.
